performance.verdict: CPL crisis is real; GBP collapse and 5 overdue SOW milestones compound the risk.

findings.text: CPL spiked 46.68% in 7 days while spend fell only 3.74% — leads dropped 34.37%, meaning fewer conversions per dollar, not a budget cut.
5 SOW milestones overdue (earliest 2026-07-23): phone-match attribution, CRM cleanup, dashboard, and August scoreboard all undelivered — renewal trust at risk.
GBP actions hit 0 for 8 consecutive days (Sep 1–8) after averaging ~9/day in August — a complete organic floor collapse with no paid offset.
3-day lead signal (Sep 6–8): 6+2+4=12 leads vs prior 3 days (Sep 3–5): 4+2+0=6 — a short recovery, but CPL context makes this fragile, not a trend reversal.
GHL returned a 401 timeout error this cycle — pipeline data is unavailable; leads-to-opps conversion cannot be verified against the 109 28-day leads.

suggestions.text: Introduce fresh creative into BWS Retargeting (51% of 28-day spend, $405.97) to address probable audience fatigue driving CPL +46.68%.
suggestions.monday_update: The BWS - Instant Leads - Retargeting campaign consumed $405.97 of $789.05 in 28-day spend while CPL rose 46.68% on a 34.37% lead drop — a classic fatigue pattern. Swap in at least 2 new ad creatives (new hook or visual) without changing audience or budget. Success check: CPL returns below the 28-day baseline of $7.24 within 7 days of launch. Re-evaluate by 2026-09-16.

suggestions.text: Escalate GBP reactivation immediately — 0 actions for 8 days erases organic floor that previously generated ~9 actions/day and supported lead volume.
suggestions.monday_update: GBP actions have been zero since September 1 after averaging approximately 9 per day through August — this is a confirmed channel-dark event that removes a free lead source during a prove-it month. Post a minimum of 3 GBP updates or Q&A responses this week and confirm the profile is not suspended or suppressed. Success check: GBP actions return above 5/day within 7 days. Re-check 2026-09-16.

suggestions.text: Resolve GHL 401 timeout and surface pipeline data — 109 leads in 28 days cannot be traced to opps or appointments without CRM access.
suggestions.monday_update: GHL returned a 401 timeout error this cycle, blocking all pipeline visibility against 109 28-day leads — this directly blocks the overdue dashboard milestone (due 2026-08-31) and the August scoreboard the client needs for renewal.
